QuestInfo.name: Corba's Suggestion
QuestInfo.0: Alpha and Beta listened to what Corba had to say about the egg conflict.
QuestInfo.1: You hear that Corba is wise yet his decision was to split the egg. Any idiot can make a ruling like that. But regardless, you have been asked to deliver the decision to #bIto#k and #bYaku#k. Ito might be okay but Yaku will faint after hearing the decision to split the egg!
QuestInfo.2: Ito seemed fine with Corba's suggestion to split the egg, but Yaku decided to give up the egg rather than cause it to be harmed.

speech.0: Corba really said that? That he'll slice the egg in half? Hm... Fine! I'd rather have half of the egg than lose it to Yaku. So tell Yaku to just give up!
What?! Slice the egg in half? That's so cruel! That'll destroy the egg!
speech.1: I'll give the egg up. I don't know what kind of tricks Ito might pull, but it'd be better than slicing it in half. Please tell #bCorba#k not to do that... Please, I beg you!

0.0: So! #bYaku#k and #bIto#k fight over dragon egg? Easy solution! Slice the egg in half, everybody wins!\r\n#L0##bS-slice the egg in half? Are you crazy, gramps? #l\n#k
0.1: The solution is simple isn't it? If the two can't get along then just split the egg! Tell #bYaku#k and #bIto#k that if they can't share then you'll slice the egg in half instead.

no.0: I will slice the egg myself if you don't.

1.0: Did you talk to Yaku and Ito?

default.0: Tell #bYaku#k and #bIto#k that if they can't share then you'll slice the egg in half instead.
